metadata.descricao: Cataloging of a physical Pokémon card collection.

home.descricao: Inventory and collections — quick add by set is the starting point for typing in the physical collection.

visaoGeral.descricao: How much you have and how it is spread out: totals, set, rarity, language, condition, variant and collection progress.

cadastroSet.descricao: Pick a set and check off the whole card grid in a single submission.

cadastroBusca.descricao: For a single card: search by name, set or number.

inventario.descricao: A list with search and filters: set, language, rarity, variant, condition, graded, location, allocated/free.

repetidas.descricao: What is left over for trading: total, allocated and free per card, with the physical language of each copy.

colecoes.descricao: Pokédex, set or custom: slot grid, copy allocation and the list of missing cards.

colecoes.elegiveisProntas: You have <forte>{total}</forte> free {total, plural, =1 {copy in your inventory that fills an empty slot} other {copies in your inventory that fill empty slots}} in some collection.
colecoes.elegiveisForaDePadrao: Another <forte>{total}</forte> eligible {total, plural, =1 {copy is} other {copies are}} outside the required language only (they need explicit confirmation).

cadastroBusca.descricao: For a single card: search by name, set or number.
cadastroBusca.erroCriterio: Give at least one criterion: name, set or number.
cadastroBusca.erroSiglaNumero: I could not read that as "set code + number" — e.g. "MEW 151" or "mew151".
cadastroBusca.somada: Added to the copy you already had of {carta} — now there {total, plural, =1 {is} other {are}} {total}.
cadastroBusca.campoSigla: Or straight from the set code printed on the card + number
cadastroBusca.nenhumaCartaAjuda: Check the set code and the number printed on the card. If it really is not in the catalog — it happens with Japanese and promo sets that TCGdex does not catalog — add it by hand.

cartaManual.abrir: Add a card that is not in the catalog
cartaManual.explicacao: For a card TCGdex does not have — such as the <forte>SMH</forte> set (Japanese GX Starter Decks). Copy what is printed on the card. Once added, it behaves like any other card, and the weekly catalog update never removes it.
cartaManual.erroRede: Network failure while adding the card.
cartaManual.ajudaDexId: The Pokédex number is what lets the card fill a slot in a Pokédex collection. Trainer and Energy cards have none — leave it blank.

seletorExpansao.erroCarregar: Failed to load the list of sets.

cadastroSet.descricao: Enter how many of each card you have. Tab moves to the next card. Each card's variant, language and condition start at the batch default set in the bar below; changing one card affects only that card. The variant selector only offers what the card actually has in the catalog.
cadastroSet.erroGrade: Failed to load the set grid.
cadastroSet.erroRede: Network failure while saving the batch.
cadastroSet.loteComFusao: {inseridas, plural, =1 {# copy} other {# copies}} saved and {fundidas} added to copies of {set} you already had.
cadastroSet.loteGravado: {inseridas, plural, =1 {# copy} other {# copies}} saved from {set}.
cadastroSet.catalogoEn: <forte>Catalog: EN</forte> — this set has no card-by-card data in Portuguese upstream. Each card's identity uses the English entry; the language below is the one of YOUR physical copy (e.g. pick <codigo>pt</codigo> if it is the Brazilian edition).
cadastroSet.filtrarNumero: Filter by number (single card — leading zeros tolerated)
cadastroSet.nenhumaCarta: No card with that number in this set.

comum.rotuloAlocacao: {total, plural, =0 {No free copy of yours fits this slot.} =1 {1 free copy of yours fits this slot.} other {# free copies of yours fit this slot.}}
comum.rotuloMelhoria: {total, plural, =0 {No free copy of yours is better than this one.} =1 {1 free copy of yours is better than the one allocated here.} other {# free copies of yours are better than the one allocated here.}}

seloOrigem.catalogo-en: Photo of the English card — the catalog has no photo of the Portuguese version.
seloOrigem.catalogo-pt: Photo of the Portuguese card — the catalog has no photo of the English version.
seloOrigem.mypcards: Photo from mypcards, not from the official TCGdex catalog.

colecaoNova.descricao: Slots are created together with the collection. Filling each slot is always manual, done after creation — the system never fills a slot on its own.
colecaoNova.campoIdiomaCatalogo: Catalog language (the identity of the cards — not the physical language of your copies)
colecaoNova.semPt: This set has no card-by-card data in pt upstream — the identity of the cards uses the en entry.
colecaoNova.incluirSecretas: Include secrets ({total} cards in total, instead of {oficiais} official)
colecaoNova.ajudaIdiomaExigido: The physical language of the copy. A copy in another language can still be allocated — it comes flagged as off-standard and needs explicit confirmation.
colecaoNova.erroRede: Network failure while creating the collection.

colecoesFalta.resumo: {vagas, plural, =1 {# empty slot} other {# empty slots}} across {colecoes, plural, =1 {# collection} other {# collections}}.
colecoesFalta.filtroAlocaveis: Show only what I can allocate now ({total}) — a free copy of yours fits the slot
colecoesFalta.nadaFalta: Nothing missing — every Pokédex and Set collection is complete (or none has been created yet).
colecoesFalta.copiasSuas: {total, plural, =1 {# copy of yours} other {# copies of yours}}
colecoesFalta.erroCarregar: Failed to load the missing cards.

visaoGeral.descricao: How much you have and how it is spread out. Click any breakdown to open the inventory already filtered.
visaoGeral.repetidasDescricao: What is left over for trading — total, allocated and free per card →

repetidas.descricao: {total, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} with 2 or more units. Sorted by free units, descending.
repetidas.soLivres: Only with free units (what you can trade)
repetidas.idiomaTitulo: {quantidade, plural, =1 {# unit} other {# units}} in {idioma}, {livres} free
repetidas.vazio: No duplicate cards (2+ units) in the inventory.
repetidas.vazioSoLivres: No duplicate card with free units right now.

imagemLocal.gatilhoTrocarTitulo: Replace or remove the image of {carta}
imagemLocal.gatilhoAdicionarTitulo: No image in the catalog — add a photo of {carta}
imagemLocal.erroRedeRemover: Network failure while removing the image.
imagemLocal.erroRedeMapear: Network failure while mapping the set.
imagemLocal.setMapeadoComFila: Set mapped. Downloading {total, plural, =1 {# photo} other {# photos}} in the background — reload in a moment.
imagemLocal.setMapeadoSemFila: Set mapped. No card in this set was missing a photo.
imagemLocal.erroColeMypcards: Paste the address of an image of the set on mypcards.
imagemLocal.erroColeLink: Paste the link to the image.
imagemLocal.erroRedeEnviar: Network failure while uploading the image.
imagemLocal.explicacaoTrocar: This card uses an image you uploaded. Upload another one to replace it, or remove it to fall back to what the catalog offers.
imagemLocal.explicacaoAdicionar: This card has no image in the catalog. Upload a file or paste a link — the image is kept in the system and applies to every copy of this card.
imagemLocal.campoMypcards: Link to any image of set {set} on mypcards
imagemLocal.ajudaMypcards: Open the set on mypcards, right-click a card and copy the image address. One link resolves the whole set: the system reads the set id and downloads every photo missing from it.
imagemLocal.ajudaArquivo: JPEG, PNG or WEBP, up to 8 MB.
imagemLocal.ajudaLink: The server downloads and keeps the file — not just the link.

inventario.descricao: {total, plural, =1 {# copy} other {# copies}} in total.
inventario.exportarLigaTitulo: ZIP with the inventory in LigaPokemon's import format, split into files of up to 995 cards.
inventario.filtroImagemTitulo: Cards with no image of their own and no image in the catalog. Some may show a photo anyway: when both are missing, the system tries the TCGdex CDN, and only the browser finds out whether the file exists.
inventario.confirmarRemoverAlocada: It is allocated to a slot, which will be left empty.
inventario.confirmarDesalocar: Remove {carta} from {colecao} (slot #{vaga})? The copy goes back to being free in the inventory.
inventario.selecionadas: {total, plural, =1 {# copy selected.} other {# copies selected.}}
inventario.vazio: No copy found with these filters.
inventario.loteDividido: The batch was split: 1 unit went to the collection, the rest stays free in the inventory.
inventario.modalAlocarExplicacao: The system suggests eligible collections/slots; the choice is always yours.
inventario.semDestinos: No collection or slot is eligible for this copy.
inventario.erroMassa: Failed to apply the bulk edit.
inventario.erroRedeMassa: Network failure while applying the bulk edit.
inventario.massaAtualizadas: {total, plural, =1 {# copy updated.} other {# copies updated.}}
inventario.massaTitulo: Edit {total, plural, =1 {# selected copy} other {# selected copies}}
inventario.massaExplicacao: Check only the fields you want to change. The allocation of the copies is not touched by this edit.
inventario.semVarianteComum: the selection mixes cards with no variant in common in the catalog — edit the variant copy by copy
inventario.massaConfirma: Confirm changing {total, plural, =1 {# copy} other {# copies}}?
inventario.massaAplicar: Apply to {total, plural, =1 {# copy} other {# copies}}

colecaoDetalhe.confirmarExcluir: Delete the collection "{nome}"? The inventory copies are not deleted — they just become free again.
colecaoDetalhe.confirmarDesalocar: Remove {alvo} from its slot? The copy goes back to the inventory as free.
colecaoDetalhe.avisoCatalogoIncompleto: The local catalog only knows {materializadas} of the {esperadas} cards of this set upstream — {faltantes} are missing. The collection does not pretend to be complete: the progress above reflects only what the local catalog has today.
colecaoDetalhe.avisoSemNumeracaoOficial: This set has no separate official numbering upstream (it is a promo collection). This collection's universe uses the {total} known cards of the whole set instead of the official count.
colecaoDetalhe.filtroSoVazias: Show empty slots only ({total}) — what this collection is missing
colecaoDetalhe.filtroSoMelhorias: Show slots with an upgrade only ({total}) — you own a better copy than the allocated one
colecaoDetalhe.vazioSoVazias: Nothing missing — every slot is filled.
colecaoDetalhe.vazioSoMelhorias: No slot with an upgrade available.
colecaoDetalhe.incluirSecretas: Include secrets (numbering beyond the official one)
colecaoDetalhe.confirmarDesligarSecretas: Turning secrets off removes the secret slots that are still empty. If any is already filled, the operation is refused. Continue?
colecaoDetalhe.legendaEscopo: Scope — add or remove a region without affecting the slots that already exist
colecaoDetalhe.confirmarRemoverRegiao: Remove {regiao} from the scope? It is only allowed if no slot of this region is filled — otherwise the operation is refused and says how many there are.
colecaoDetalhe.erroRedeEscopo: Network failure while changing the scope.
colecaoDetalhe.vagasAdicionadas: {total, plural, =1 {# slot added} other {# slots added}}
colecaoDetalhe.vagasRemovidas: {total, plural, =1 {# slot removed} other {# slots removed}}
colecaoDetalhe.escopoInalterado: The scope was already like that.
colecaoDetalhe.campoAdicionarLivre: Add a free copy from the inventory
colecaoDetalhe.erroBuscarLivres: Failed to search for free copies.
colecaoDetalhe.loteDivididoColecao: The batch was split: 1 unit went to the collection, the rest stays free in the inventory.
colecaoDetalhe.loteDivididoVaga: The batch was split: 1 unit went to the slot, the rest stays free in the inventory.
colecaoDetalhe.modalAlocarExplicacao: The system suggests candidates; the choice is always yours.
colecaoDetalhe.semCandidatos: No free copy in the inventory for this slot.
colecaoDetalhe.modalMelhoriaExplicacao: These free copies of yours are better than the allocated one. The system suggests and ranks; the swap is always yours.
colecaoDetalhe.trocaFeita: Slot #{vaga}: {entrou} ({setEntrou}) took the place of {saiu} ({setSaiu}), which went back to the inventory as free.
colecaoDetalhe.erroRedeDescartar: Network failure while dismissing the suggestion.
colecaoDetalhe.descartarTitulo: Hides this suggestion, for this slot only. A better copy that shows up later will flag it again.

opcoesCompra.descricaoSet: LigaPokemon prices for the cards missing from this set. Each slot has a single card — the decision to buy is yours.
opcoesCompra.descricaoPokedex: LigaPokemon prices for the empty slots of this Pokédex. The system filters and ranks; the choice is yours.
opcoesCompra.erroIniciar: Could not start the price scan.
opcoesCompra.erroMarcacao: The selection was not saved. Reload the page.
opcoesCompra.erroCopiar: Could not copy automatically — select the text above and copy it by hand.
opcoesCompra.todasJaMarcadas: Every slot with an offer already has a card selected.
opcoesCompra.ritmoEnv: One request every {intervalo}, set in LIGA_INTERVALO_SEGUNDOS.
opcoesCompra.ritmoRobots: One request every {intervalo}, which is the Crawl-delay in their robots.txt.
opcoesCompra.ritmoConservador: One request every {intervalo}: their robots.txt could not be read, and without a reading the conservative value applies.
opcoesCompra.varreduraIniciada: Price scan started: {vagas, plural, =1 {# slot} other {# slots}}, estimated {estimativa} (expected to finish {previsao}).
opcoesCompra.varreduraPuladas: {total, plural, =1 {# slot} other {# slots}} already had a recent lookup and {total, plural, =1 {was} other {were}} skipped.
opcoesCompra.varreduraPodeSair: You can leave this screen — the result is saved, and firing it again picks up where it stopped.
opcoesCompra.reconsultarTudo: Scan everything again (ignores what was already looked up)
opcoesCompra.explicacaoFrescor: A slot looked up in the last {horas} hours is skipped, so firing it again picks up where it stopped. Reverse and holo do not come in here: the variant belongs to the offer, not to the card — it shows up when you open a specific card.
opcoesCompra.explicacaoSet: In a set, the search is by card name and only the right edition and number count: a reprint in another edition does not fill the slot.
opcoesCompra.resumoVarredura: {vagas, plural, =1 {# slot} other {# slots}} looked up · {requisicoes, plural, =1 {# request} other {# requests}}
opcoesCompra.faltamVagas: {total, plural, =1 {# slot left} other {# slots left}}
opcoesCompra.telaSeAtualiza: the screen refreshes on its own; you can leave and come back
opcoesCompra.vagasSemOferta: {total, plural, =1 {# slot} other {# slots}} with no offer
opcoesCompra.vagasSemOpcao: {total, plural, =1 {# slot} other {# slots}} with no option
opcoesCompra.varreduraInterrompida: The price scan stopped before the end: {erro} What was already looked up is still below.
opcoesCompra.marcarMelhor: Select the best of each slot
opcoesCompra.marcarMelhorAjuda: Selects the first option of the slots that still have no card chosen — the best one by the sort order you picked.
opcoesCompra.cartasNaLista: {total, plural, =1 {# card} other {# cards}} on the list · {valor}
opcoesCompra.semPrecoTitulo: Cards that did not show up in the last price scan. They stay on the list with the price from last time — or with no price, when there never was one.
opcoesCompra.guardadasTitulo: Cards you chose whose slot is already filled. They leave the string but are kept — if the copy leaves the slot, they come back.
opcoesCompra.guardadas: {total, plural, =1 {# already added} other {# already added}}, off the list
opcoesCompra.compraPorLista: Buy by List — text to paste
opcoesCompra.comoColar: Paste it into their Buy by List. Under “Adicionar Detalhes”, Quality: <forte>NM</forte>. Grouping by store is done by Liga, under “Otimizar minha Lista de Compras”.
opcoesCompra.listaGuardada: The list is kept: it survives a new price scan (which updates the prices instead of wiping the shortlist) and shrinks on its own as you add the cards.
opcoesCompra.totalEhPiso: The {valor} is the lowest price of each card in any condition — a floor for checking, not a budget in NM.
opcoesCompra.esconderSemOferta: Hide slots with no offer at all
opcoesCompra.esconderSemOpcao: Hide slots with no option at all
opcoesCompra.vazioComLista: Your shopping list is above, ready to paste. Fire a search whenever you want to refresh the prices.
opcoesCompra.vazioSemVarredura: No price scan yet. Pick the parameters above and fire the first search.
opcoesCompra.semOfertaSet: No offer in stock for this card within the filters.
opcoesCompra.semOpcaoPokedex: No card in stock within the cap.
opcoesCompra.foraDoCatalogoTitulo: Not in our catalog: if you buy it, adding it afterwards is manual

recusas.arquivoAcimaDoLimite: File larger than the {mb} MB limit.
recusas.arquivoNaoEhImagem: File not recognized as a JPEG, PNG or WEBP image (checked by its content, not by its extension).
recusas.cartaDeCatalogoDaCopiaNaoEncontrada: The copy's catalog card was not found.
recusas.cartaNaoEncontradaNoCatalogo: Card {cartaId} ({idioma}) not found in the catalog.
recusas.colecaoDaVagaNaoEncontrada: The slot's collection was not found.
recusas.conflitoAoGerarProximaVaga: Conflict while creating the next slot — try again.
recusas.copiaJaAlocada: This copy is already allocated to another slot.
recusas.copiaJaNestaVaga: This copy is already in this slot.
recusas.copiasNaoEncontradasNadaAlterado: Copies not found, nothing was changed: {ids}
recusas.customizadaNaoTemTroca: A custom collection has no swap — remove the copy and add the other one.
recusas.downloadAcimaDoLimite: The image exceeds the {mb} MB limit.
recusas.downloadExcessoRedirecionamentos: Too many redirects while downloading the image.
recusas.downloadFalhaDeRede: Network failure while downloading the image.
recusas.downloadRedirecionamentoSemDestino: The URL redirected without naming a destination.
recusas.downloadRespostaComErro: The URL answered with an error (HTTP {status}).
recusas.downloadTempoEsgotado: Timed out while downloading the image.
recusas.escopoSoEmPokedex: Only Pokédex collections have an editable scope.
recusas.falhaAoBaixarImagemDaUrl: Failed to download the image from the URL.
recusas.falhaAoGravarCopia: Failed to save — check that the card exists in the catalog you named.
recusas.falhaAoGravarLote: Failed to save the batch — check that every card exists in the catalog you named.
recusas.fluxoSoParaCustomizada: Only custom collections use this flow — pokedex and set allocate to a slot that already exists (POST /api/vagas/:id/alocar).
recusas.idiomaExigido: This collection requires copies in ''{exigido}''; this copy is in ''{copia}''. Send permitirForaDePadrao to accept it anyway.
recusas.linkDeOutroSet: The link is for set "{link}", not for "{esperado}".
recusas.linkNaoEhMypcards: That does not look like a mypcards image link. Copy the address of a card's image (img.mypcards.com/...).
recusas.multiplosNumerosPokedex: A card with more than one Pokédex number (tag team / multi-Pokémon card) does not fill a Pokédex slot — ineligible, with no exception.
recusas.opcoesDeCompraSoPokedexOuSet: Buy options exist for collections of the Pokédex or set kind.
recusas.outroNumeroDoSet: This card is number ''{carta}'' of the set; the slot is number ''{vaga}''.
recusas.outroNumeroPokedex: This card is Pokémon no. {carta}; the slot is no. {vaga}.
recusas.outroSet: This card is from set ''{carta}''; the slot is from set ''{vaga}''.
recusas.secretasPreenchidas: Cannot turn it off: {total} secret slot(s) already filled.
recusas.secretasSoEmSet: Only set collections have the include-secrets flag.
recusas.semNumeroPokedex: A card with no Pokédex number (Trainer/Energy) does not fill a Pokédex slot.
recusas.semVagaVaziaComCartaIdentificavel: No empty slot with an identifiable card in this collection.
recusas.semVagaVaziaComEspecieIdentificavel: No empty slot with an identifiable species in this collection.
recusas.setNaoEncontradoNoCatalogo: Set not found in the catalog.
recusas.setNaoEncontradoNoCatalogoEmIdioma: Set ''{setId}'' not found in the catalog in ''{idioma}''.
recusas.setSemCartaUtilizavel: Set ''{setId}'' has no usable card in the catalog in ''{idioma}''.
recusas.setSemNumeracaoOficialSeparada: This set has no separate official numbering upstream — there is no official/secret distinction to toggle.
recusas.urlEsquemaNaoAceito: Only http:// or https:// URLs are accepted.
recusas.vagaVaziaUseAlocacao: The slot is empty — use allocation, not a swap.
recusas.vagasJaConsultadas: The {total} slot(s) of this collection were already queried in the last {horas} hours. Send validadeHoras: 0 to query everything again.
recusas.varianteForaDoCatalogoDaCarta: Variant outside the catalog for this card.
recusas.varianteForaDoCatalogoNaSelecao: Variant ''{variante}'' does not exist in the catalog for {total} card(s) in the selection — no copy was changed.
recusas.varianteForaDoCatalogoNoLote: Variant outside the catalog on one or more cards.
recusas.varreduraEmAndamento: There is already a scan running on this collection. Wait for it to finish.
